sections.title: Part 3 — Style Lock (copied)
sections.md:
- **Format:** one creator in a bathrobe, talking to the front camera in one sitting, doing the product on her own face as she talks.
- **Visual grammar:** selfie MCU, arm's length, slight handheld drift; the product held up to the lens (carton, stick); the white balm dotted on forehead, cheeks, chin, then blended with the fingers on camera — the colour change happens live.
- **Light:** dim indoor evening room, warm practicals (a chandelier behind), soft key from the front — flat but honest; skin not retouched.
- **Rhythm:** no cuts for 25 s at a time; energy comes from her hands, the product moving toward the lens, and the reveal of the matched skin.
- **Tone:** annoyed-sounding opener that flips — a fake-out list of "it's not because…", deadpan, then the deal.

sections.title: Part 4 — script absorption
sections.md: The script is the inspo's fake-out retold tighter: **an angry open ("I am so mad… I am going to be returning it") → four "it's not because…" reasons that are each a benefit → the twist: she's returning it only to rebuy on the sale → CTA with urgency → the brand line "It was never your skin. It was the formula."** 284 spoken words, six lines (L1–L6), spoken verbatim (§22U).

summary.label: Length
summary.value: About 1½ minutes — one woman talking to her phone in her bathrobe, with close-ups of the stick on her face

summary.label: Pace
summary.value: Fast and chatty, like a real TikTok: she barely stops talking; the close-ups change every 2–3 seconds

summary.label: Voice
summary.value: Her own voice — a warm, quick American woman in her mid-40s, annoyed at first, then clearly delighted

summary.label: On screen
summary.value: Her face to the camera, the white stick going on her cheek and turning her shade, her skin before and after, the sale bundle

summary.label: Opening
summary.value: “I am so mad…” — she sounds furious and says she's returning the stick

summary.label: Ending
summary.value: The twist: she only returns it to buy the 2-for-1 deal — “It was never your skin. It was the formula.”

summary.label: We do better
summary.value: The colour change shown clearly up close, her real skin problems before, the offer items shown, three different hooks

summary.label: We leave out
summary.value: The knife, the other brand's pink box, the inspo's laser-treatment line
